_comment: What each role may SEE. Every role's answer is understood from the same facts, code included; these switches decide presentation (names, endpoints, paths, quoted source) and are enforced in the service -- the facts are tagged, every event is filtered, and code-shaped text in prose or status lines is scrubbed. Unknown staff get default_role. Change a role here; nobody edits code for it.

_capabilities.style: simple = always the plain-English answer; auto = the intent router decides (technical for code questions)
_capabilities.code_names: class, method, model, job names may appear in the answer and the trace; false = they are scrubbed from prose and status lines and code claims/evidence never reach the browser -- the writer still reads them to understand
_capabilities.endpoints: HTTP routes and call sites may appear even when code_names is false
_capabilities.paths: file paths and line numbers may appear; false strips them from facts, claims, evidence and prose
_capabilities.code_source: source code may be QUOTED in the answer; false = the writer still reads source to understand behaviour but describes the logic in words
_capabilities.refs: branches the role may ask about; "*" = all indexed refs
_capabilities.admin: may change roles with src/users.mjs (informational; the CLI runs on the server)
